correctness.rationale: For X=u⊗α and Y=v⊗β with α(u)=β(v)=0, commuting forces XY=YX=0; otherwise nonzero equality implies the two matrices proportional and product zero. In each clique image sum P lies in common kernel K, so clique lies in C_K. In C_W, images span W and common kernels intersect to W, proving maximality and unique W. Counting rank-one tensors up to q−1 scalars yields C_W size and exact intersection formula using W∩U and W+U; balancing k gives clique number. Independently built every rank-one squarezero matrix and maximal clique over F2 for n=2,3,4: vertices 3,21,105 and maximal cliques 3,14,65, size strata n4: 35 of size9 and 30 of size7.
